      Interpretation

      These are direct syntactic constant references in Lean’s elaborated environment. They include private and generated declarations. Selecting dependencies repeatedly explores the local transitive closure. An external node is a boundary, not a claim that it has no further dependencies. Definitions as well as theorems occur in proof terms; this graph does not replace the axiom audit or certify correspondence with the paper.
